work.title: Walden
work.note: Walden é um livro do escritor americano Henry David Thoreau, publicado em 1854. A cena cultural serve de ponte para o foco “falar de uma subida: reach the top (chegar ao topo) e enjoy the view (curtir a vista)”. A referência mostra uma caminhada no bosque: reach the top, enjoy the view.

facts.label: Perguntar sobre o aluguel
facts.sub: Pergunte How much is the rent? e Are the utilities included? Pergunte Is there internet? e Can I use the kitchen? Confira regras com Are pets allowed?

facts.label: Quarto para alugar
facts.sub: Nos EUA, muita gente divide casa com outras pessoas. Os anúncios mostram o preço mensal, o que está incluído e as regras da casa.

facts.label: Contas da casa
facts.sub: Utilities são água, luz, gás e internet. Alguns aluguéis incluem tudo, e outros cobram à parte. Pergunte sempre antes de assinar.

pages.title: A room for six hundred dollars · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning on a quiet street in Austin. Ben stands in front of a yellow house with a small garden. He looks for a room to rent near his new job. A woman named Joy opens the door with a smile. The hall smells like fresh paint and coffee. She shows him a bright room with a big window.
“Hi! Come in. This is the room for rent.” says Joy. “It is nice. How much is the rent?” says Ben. “It is six hundred dollars a month.” says Joy.

pages.title: A room for six hundred dollars · 3/3
paragraphs: “Good. Is there a parking space, and are pets allowed?” says Ben. “There is one space. No pets, sorry.” says Joy. Ben looks at the bed, the desk and the closet. The room is small, but it is clean and quiet. He writes the price and the rules in his notebook. He thinks about the free Wi-Fi and the shared kitchen. Before he leaves, he asks to see the bathroom. Good questions help him choose the right place.
